scope: One larger facility-location instance: six facilities and six customers, 42 binary variables. Refit existing 20/30-qubit cases under the identical explicit-MPS-gradient budgets to produce a within-family finite-size comparison. Existing 20/30 outcomes are known; the 42-qubit seed is fixed before its results. One instance at each width is exploratory, not a population scaling law.
targets: Twelve fixed-duration digitization intervals to either s=0.5 or s=1.0. Keep the complete normalized QUBO and existing encoding. Reuse archived converged 20/30 target MPS with source hashes and their original preparation time; build new 42-qubit targets sequentially. Report endpoints separately; no quarter-schedule fallback. MPS convergence is a numerical check, not an exact certificate at 30/42 qubits.
fitting: Same native ansatz as prior studies. One fixed-seed start per depth. L0 starts near zero; each deeper fit starts from an identity extension of the best verified shallower result plus deterministic 0.01 perturbation. Explicit AQC-Tensor gradients, 120 iterations or 90-second completed-evaluation boundary per fit. Hard outer process deadlines. Preserve every attempt, incomplete record and resource failure. Validate ansatz bond convergence and independent target overlap; exact checks only for 20 or fewer qubits. No dense state vectors or 2^n enumeration above 20 qubits.
selection: Minimum CZ depth reaching verified fidelity >=0.98 is the primary resource endpoint, separately for half/full targets at each width. If no fit qualifies, report threshold unmet rather than a successful constant-depth compression. Report maximum verified fidelity as a secondary result, with all fitting costs and failures. No changes to target, normalization, depth pool or budget based on observed new outcomes.
hardware_gate: Only a verified 42-qubit fit reaching >=0.98 can trigger a new bounded hardware pilot. Prefer the full endpoint, otherwise label a half-endpoint pilot explicitly. Compare selected native preparation, fitted product state, its uncompressed 12-step target and a two-step same-duration/endpoint control; two blocks of 8192 shots per method, at most 65536 shots total. Freeze circuits/statistics before submission. If the accuracy gate is unmet, do not spend QPU shots on this fixed-accuracy validation. Hardware feasibility alone would not validate fidelity.
memory: One numerical worker; hard 4 GiB address-space limit, 3 GiB whole-worker RSS watchdog, 12 GiB system reserve. These are reproducibility settings, not a scientific contribution.
